question: Treat the human pose estimator as a transfer-gap stage: choose it per demo x arm on dev seeds, verify on held-out. Does per-demo selection beat always using GEM-X?
motivation: pose_estimator_bakeoff_v1 (a59eef6): neither estimator dominates; Fast SAM 3D Body is 1.5-13x jitterier per frame
candidate_note: fast_sam_3d_body_smooth = errors_demo._smooth_path with SMOOTH_WINDOW_S (0.20 s, unchanged since demo_budget_v1) applied to the v1 Fast SAM demo; no new parameter
selection_rule: max dev successes with the demo's frozen stack; ties -> candidate order (gemx first)
primary_metric: total held-out successes over 10 demo x arm cells, selected vs gemx (paired by seed per cell)
